title: Review the Phase 3 Quick-Cast Arcane Dock and Talent Bar
description: Read-only cross-agent review of the implementation commit and verification in HANDOFF.md. Return APPROVE, REQUEST_CHANGES, or NEEDS_DISCUSSION with specific findings and file locations. Keep the assigned worktree read-only during this adapter run. Publication is a separate step for the publishing manager after review.
acceptance_criteria: Trace the native spell and ability entry points, targeting, confirmation, and resource checks.
Check that mixed inputs cannot leak a selection into a later prompt and that native keyboard replay remains usable.
Check live slot metadata, native hotkey labels, MP and status restrictions, authentic sprites, and the memorisation fallback.
Check the dock placement with the Action Dock, Chronicle, chat, and sidebar at the four tested viewport sizes.
